mechanism: Eslicarbazepine is a CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 inducer that may increase dapagliflozin metabolism, potentially reducing its efficacy; additionally, both drugs can cause osmotic diuresis and volume depletion.
action: Monitor glycemic control closely and assess volume status; consider dapagliflozin dose adjustment if hyperglycemia occurs; educate patient on hydration and signs of euglycemic DKA.
